gloss: travel destination; place one is traveling

definitions.gloss: travel destination; place one travels to
definitions.explanation: The place one goes to or is staying at on a trip. The suffix {先|さき} marks the destination or place where an action occurs.

examples.japanese: {旅行先|りょこうさき}を{決|き}めた。
examples.english: We decided on a travel destination.

examples.japanese: {旅行先|りょこうさき}で{財布|さいふ}をなくした。
examples.english: I lost my wallet at my travel destination.

examples.japanese: {旅行先|りょこうさき}では、その{土地|とち}でしか{食|た}べられない{料理|りょうり}を{楽|たの}しみたい。
examples.english: When traveling, I want to enjoy dishes you can only eat in that region.

notes:
Compound of {旅行|りょこう} (travel) + the suffix {先|さき} (destination, place where something happens). The same {先|さき} appears in {勤|つと}め{先|さき} (place of work) and {連絡|れんらく}{先|さき} (contact address).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅行先|りょこうさき}を{決|き}める: to decide on a destination
- {旅行先|りょこうさき}で: while at one's travel destination
- {人気|にんき}の{旅行先|りょこうさき}: a popular travel destination

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {目的地|もくてきち}: destination — the specific place one is headed; more neutral and precise
- {行|い}き{先|さき}: where one is going — broader, used for any outing, not only trips
